name: Gateway to the Frontier
label: Quest
description: Gateway to the Frontier: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: They say that Ashenvale is the new frontier, and that the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens is the gateway to it. That would be so cool to be a pioneer, carving everything you need out of the untamed wilds! They say that this is where the Horde and Alliance will clash the most in the future, and I want to be there friend!
Would you take me to the Mor'shan Rampart so I can see what the frontier looks like, please? I wanna see where the Horde is driving out those smelly night elves!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wow, Ashenvale is where real adventure happens! Have you ever fought in Ashenvale, friend? When I become a hero when I grow up, I wanna come to Ashenvale and fight for the glory Horde!
Thank you for taking me to the frontier, friend. You're the best!
